##### Project general facts

Yas Riva is an exclusive waterfront villa community by Aldar, where contemporary architecture is thoughtfully inspired by the natural harmony of light and water. Designed with elegant proportions, organic materials, and timeless aesthetics, the development offers a refined collection of luxurious residences that blend seamlessly with their surroundings. Every home reflects a balance of modern sophistication and natural beauty, creating a peaceful retreat in one of Abu Dhabi’s most desirable destinations.

Life at Yas Riva is centered around comfort, tranquility, and a strong connection to the surrounding environment. The community is designed to provide a warm and welcoming atmosphere where elegant architecture and open spaces encourage a relaxed lifestyle while maintaining a sense of exclusivity. Whether enjoying quiet moments at home or embracing the vibrant surroundings of Yas Island, residents experience a lifestyle that combines contemporary luxury with everyday ease.

Inside, the residences feature spacious, thoughtfully designed interiors finished with high-quality contemporary materials. Homeowners can personalize their living spaces by selecting from sophisticated light or dark interior palettes, creating homes that reflect their own style and preferences. Equipped kitchens complement the elegant layouts, while the unfurnished interiors offer the flexibility to create a truly bespoke living environment, resulting in homes that perfectly balance functionality, comfort, and timeless design.

##### Location description and benefits

Yas Island, situated in Abu Dhabi, is a sprawling leisure and entertainment destination that has garnered global acclaim. This man-made island covers approximately 9.6 square kilometers (3.7 square miles) and offers a wide array of world-class attractions. One of its highlights is the renowned Yas Marina Circuit, which hosts the exhilarating Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, attracting racing enthusiasts from around the world.

At the heart of Yas Island is Ferrari World Abu Dhabi, an indoor theme park dedicated to the legendary Italian sports car manufacturer. This extraordinary park enthralls visitors with its thrilling rides, including the record-breaking Formula Rossa roller coaster that accelerates to speeds of up to 240 kilometers per hour (149 miles per hour). Ferrari World also presents captivating exhibits showcasing the brand's history and heritage.

Yas Island's aquatic paradise, Yas Waterworld, offers a refreshing escape from the desert heat. Packed with exhilarating water slides, rides, and pools suitable for all ages, this water park is a must-visit for families and adventure-seekers. Yas Waterworld incorporates Emirati culture and traditions into its design, creating a one-of-a-kind experience that showcases the region's rich heritage.
